title: docs: make mem:<name> pointers in plan steps the standard, and retire a task's Serena handoff when QA approves it
description:
Requested by the human on 2026-10-30 after a governor audit of Serena usage, covering Serena logs for 10-27 to 10-30: 980 Serena sessions and 4,112 tool calls.

What works: architects already write `mem:<name>` pointers into plan steps, for example `mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate` and `mem:gotcha-proxy-npm-test-shared-checkout-deletes-dist`, so workers read exactly the right memory. That is why only 82 of 980 sessions needed list_memories. It is done ad hoc, though; no role doc asks for it.

What leaks: task-<id>-handoff memories never get retired. 304 of 349 belong to DONE or ARCHIVED tasks, and nothing in the lifecycle removes them.

Change, keeping the role docs inside npm run lint's 40-line cap for architect/worker/qa .md, with the detail in the .reference.md files and docs/MEMORY.md:
1. Architect (docs/roles/architect.md, plus the moe-planning skill where plan steps are described): when a Serena memory bears on a step, name it in that step as `mem:<name>` instead of expecting workers to scan list_memories.
2. QA (docs/roles/qa.md / qa.reference.md): after moe.qa_approve, fold anything reusable from the task's handoff into a gotcha-/pattern-/decision- memory, then retire the handoff. Archive it into .serena/memories/_archive/, which the companion cleanup task hides from list_memories through ignored_memory_patterns, or delete it if nothing reusable remains. A rejected task keeps its handoff.
3. docs/MEMORY.md: document the handoff lifecycle (written while the task is open, retired at QA approval), the `_archive/` convention, and the `mem:` pointer convention.

Role docs reach running seats only after the daemon is rebuilt, because .moe/roles is re-synced at daemon boot, and after a plugin rebuild for IDE users. Say so in the completion summary.
definitionOfDone: docs/roles/architect.md (or the moe-planning skill it points to) tells architects to name relevant Serena memories in plan steps as `mem:<name>`. docs/MEMORY.md describes the convention.

docs/roles/qa.md / qa.reference.md tell QA, after qa_approve, to fold reusable facts from task-<id>-handoff into a gotcha/pattern/decision memory and then retire the handoff (archive to .serena/memories/_archive/, or delete). A rejected task keeps its handoff. docs/MEMORY.md documents this lifecycle.

`npm run lint` at the repo root passes (the 40-line cap holds), the daemon prebuild still regenerates initFiles.ts and skillFiles.ts cleanly, and the completion summary notes that seats pick the change up at the next daemon or plugin rebuild.
